title: Warm Crispy Venezuelan Chicken Empanadas
description: A crispy and flavorful Venezuelan dish featuring chicken and citrus, perfect for a date night, this recipe is low in sodium and uses render fat for added flavor, the empanadas are boiled in water before being fried to a crispy golden brown.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the orange juice, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken breast to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Heat the render fat in a large skillet over medium heat.
Remove the chicken from the marinade and cook in the skillet until browned on all sides.
Add the onion and garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Roll out the empanada dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a tablespoon of the chicken mixture onto the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough in half and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Bring the water to a boil in a large pot and gently add the empanadas to the pot.
Boil the empanadas for 5 minutes, then remove them from the water with a slotted spoon.
Heat about 1/2 inch of render fat in a large skillet over medium heat and fry the empanadas until crispy and golden brown.
